section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 2, which conducted a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the 10-item BAS-2 using two samples: college students (N = 263; women n = 161, men n = 102) and an MTurk online community sample (N = 317; women n = 150, men n = 167). The CFA tested a one-factor BAS-2 model and measurement invariance across sex and sample type, and the section also tested discriminant validity versus impression management. The Note lists Study 1, Study 2, and Study 3 sample sizes.

section_summary.extract_value: Study 2 conducted a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the 10-item BAS-2 to test whether the one-factor structure found in Study 1 replicates in a college student sample and an online community (MTurk) sample, and tested measurement invariance across sex and sample type. The note reports sample sizes: Study 2 college N = 263 (women n = 161, men n = 102) and MTurk community N = 317 (women n = 150, men n = 167); the section also examined discriminant validity versus impression management.
